name: 圣域之卵·男·化形
src: 主角预设（11-10）：真龙幼体·圣域之卵，男，化形
who: A young true dragon in human form, hatched in the innermost sanctum of Dragon Rest Ridge, about twenty, a young adult and clearly a grown man, a guild adventurer just starting out: about 180 cm, tall and lean-strong. Soft, slightly wind-tousled white hair shading to pale sunrise orange at the tips, bright red-gold eyes with vertical slit pupils, a calm, innocent, finely made face that has not yet learned to hide what it feels. Two short pale stone-white horns sweeping back from the brow, and a band of pale stone-white scales along the jaw and down the sides of the neck; faint red lightning-lines glow at the base of the horns. No tail. Fair skin. A curious, solemn, slightly unworldly air, as if everything is new.
build: About 180 cm, tall and lean, with long limbs and a light, strong frame; clearly an adult man.
palette: stone white and sunrise orange, pale gold, a little black, one small red-lightning accent
casual: His everyday adventurer's kit, chosen for him by the sanctum keepers: a fitted cream wool coat with a stand collar buttoned to the throat and pale gold piping, a loose white scarf, a narrow belt with a small pouch and a bronze guild token, slim dark trousers tucked into tall grey boots, a short sand-coloured half-cape on one shoulder. One hand lightly touching the scarf, an open, curious look.
private: At his lodging in the evening: a soft undyed linen shirt with the sleeves rolled to the elbow, a loose knitted grey vest, comfortable trousers, soft house shoes. He holds a cup of hot milk with both hands, studying it with interest. A quiet, wondering expression.
battle: A young dragon's starting gear: a fitted white-and-cream fencing coat with a high collar and pale gold piping, light steel plates on the shoulders and forearms, a narrow belt, dark trousers, tall boots. In his right hand a plain iron longsword held point-up, its fuller faintly glowing red along one line; his left hand loose and open. A straight, careful stance.
formal: Sanctum ceremonial dress: a long white wool tailored coat with a high collar, pale gold piping and a row of small gold buttons, a narrow red-gold sash from shoulder to belt, white gloves, polished boots. Standing very straight and solemn, hands at his sides.
art: A three-quarter view, the sword held before him so that its faint red glow lights one slit-pupilled eye, white hair lifted by a gentle wind, a sincere, slightly startled look at the viewer.
battle_note: No tail; both short horns stay bare, never covered by a hat or helmet; the stone-white scales on the jaw and neck stay visible above the collar; the faint red lightning-lines glow at the base of the horns.

build: About 170 cm, slender and light, with long fine limbs; clearly a young adult woman.
palette: stone white and coral copper, soft gold, pale grey, one small red-lightning accent
casual: Her everyday adventurer's kit, chosen for her by the sanctum keepers: a fitted cream wool coat with a stand collar buttoned to the throat and pale gold piping, a loose white scarf, a narrow belt with a small pouch and a bronze guild token, a knee-length grey skirt over long dark stockings, soft tall grey boots, a short sand-coloured half-cape on one shoulder. Both hands holding the scarf ends, an open, curious look.
private: At home in the evening: a long soft white knitted dress with long sleeves and a modest collar, a pale gold shawl, hair loose, soft slippers. She holds a cup of hot milk in both hands, studying it with interest. A quiet, wondering smile.
battle: A young dragon's starting gear: a fitted white-and-cream coat with a high collar and pale gold piping, light steel plates on the shoulders and forearms, a narrow belt, dark leggings under a short split skirt, tall boots. art: Holding the shortsword before her so that its faint red glow lights one slit-pupilled eye, coral hair lifted by a gentle wind, a sincere, slightly startled look at the viewer.
battle_note: No tail; both short horns stay bare, never covered by a hat or helmet; the scale patch at the temple on the viewer's right and the scales on the neck stay visible above the collar; the faint red lightning-lines glow at the base of the horns.

Hands in the coat's pockets, a wary, watchful look. Both horns bare.
private: At his lodging in the evening: an old, much-washed oatmeal shirt with the sleeves rolled up, a thick knitted brown vest, loose trousers, thick socks. He holds a tin cup and a hunk of bread, guarding it a little. A tired, guarded half-smile. Both horns bare.
formal: A borrowed formal outfit, re-tailored to fit: a long dark grey wool coat with a high collar, plain bone-coloured buttons and no piping, a narrow brown sash, thin white gloves, dark trousers and polished but old boots. Standing straight but visibly unused to it. Both horns bare.
